example_en: At first I didn’t see the man, until he waved.

example_en: It hasn’t rained yet, but it will soon.

example_en: This hotel also offers a view of the sea.

example_en: The hotel has ten rooms altogether.

example_en: In the meantime they got used to the new school.

definition: just as, as much as, as well

example_en: I like my brother as much as my sister.

example_en: She’s pretty sure she passed the exam.

example_en: Each group has one leader.

example_en: I failed the exam, but at least I tried.

example_en: Max dreams of opening a restaurant some day.

example_en: I can bring you some milk, because I have to go shopping anyway.

definition: once, at one time, one day

example_en: In America there once lived peoples that no longer exist.

example_en: In the end we stayed home because we couldn’t agree on a movie.

definition: as far as that goes, insofar, therefore

example_en: I didn’t expect to finish second, and therefore I am more than satisfied.

example_en: Partners must trust each other.

example_de: Soweit ich weiß, findet das Seminar heute nicht statt.
example_en: As far as I know, the seminar isn’t taking place today.

definition: of all people, of all times

example_en: The international and German students can learn a lot from each other.

example_en: Because many students did not understand it, the professor explains the problem again.
